title: Validation documentation package | Aquemi
meta: Every document we deliver by phase: functional specification, P&IDs, material certificates, weld logs, FAT, SAT and IQ/OQ protocols, turnover package.
headline: The documents arrive with the equipment
lead: We write the documentation package as we design and build, not after shipment. Your validation team receives drafts for review at each phase and a complete turnover package at handover.

items.d: URS review and response, compliance matrix, basis of design, functional specification (FS), initial risk assessment.
Piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), general arrangement drawings, isometric drawings, design specification, software and hardware design specifications, requirements traceability matrix.
Material certificates, weld map and weld log, welder and procedure qualifications, borescope records, surface finish and passivation reports, pressure test records.
FAT protocol for your approval before testing, executed FAT report with deviations and their closure.
SAT protocol and report, loop and instrument check sheets, punch list and close-out.
Installation qualification (IQ) and operational qualification (OQ) protocols, executed reports, support for your performance qualification (PQ).
Turnover package, operation and maintenance manual, spare parts list, training records.

rows: Scope, purchase order references, system tag list, approved document register
FS, design specification, software design specification, configuration specification
As-built P&IDs, general arrangement, isometrics with weld numbers, electrical schematics, panel layout
Material certificates (EN 10204 type 3.1) for product-contact components, elastomer compliance statements (FDA 21 CFR 177, USP <88> Class VI)
Weld map, weld log, welding procedure specifications (WPS), procedure qualification records (PQR), welder qualifications, borescope records
Surface finish reports, cleaning and passivation certificate, slope verification
Pressure test certificates, CRN registration, vessel data reports
Instrument list, datasheets, calibration certificates traceable to national standards
Software version record, alarm list, backup of the control program, Part 11 assessment
Executed FAT and SAT, IQ/OQ protocols and reports, deviation log
Operation and maintenance manual, recommended spare parts, preventive maintenance schedule
Training plan, attendance records, operator quick reference

blocks.body: If your site has validation templates, we write the FAT, SAT and IQ/OQ protocols in them. If not, we use ours, built on GAMP 5 and the ISPE commissioning and qualification guide.

items: Redacted IQ/OQ protocol table of contents
Sample weld log and weld map

items.q: When do we see the protocols?
items.a: The FAT protocol goes to you for approval [number] weeks before testing. IQ/OQ protocols follow the FAT so that results can be referenced, not repeated.
Yes, as indexed and bookmarked PDF files, with native drawings on request. Paper copies are available if your site requires them.

items.q: Can FAT results count towards qualification?
items.a: Where your quality unit agrees, yes. We follow the ASTM E2500 and ISPE approach: engineering tests carried out under good documentation practice can be leveraged in IQ/OQ.

cta.h: See a sample before you commit
cta.body: We share a redacted turnover index and FAT protocol with your validation lead.
